JIPMER Group A Non-Faculty Online Form 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Jawaharlal Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education and Research (JIPMER) has released the Notification for the recruitment of JIPMER Exam 2026. This recruitment has been issued for 34 posts. Applications for the JIPMER Group A Non-Faculty Recruitment 2026 has Started from 12 June 2026, & Candidate can apply till 01 July 2026.  Candidates must check the complete details for JIPMER Group A Non-Faculty Recruitment 2026 which has given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 12 June 2026
  • Last Date : 01 July 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 01 July 2026
  • Exam Date : 15 July 2026
  • Admit Card : Before Exam
  • Result Available : Available Soon

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 1500/-
  • SC, ST, : Rs. 1200/-
  • PH Candidate : Rs. 0/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
